notes: Initial test type check failed because existing scheduler fixtures used Promise.withResolvers with ES2022 types. Fixtures now use ordinary promises; test types and all five scheduler fixture tests passed afterward.

Package tests emitted MaxListenersExceededWarning and plugin timing warnings; the docs build emitted its large-chunk advisory. No warnings were suppressed.
